explanation.summaryZh: 语篇介绍围棋展览，考查关系代词、冠词、非谓语、名词、被动语态、主谓一致、介词、形容词、副词和并列连词。
explanation.ruleZh: 语法填空先判断句子成分，再根据固定搭配、语态、时态、词性和上下文完成形式变化。

segments.text: An exhibition at the Jiushi Art Museum in Shanghai is featuring artwork inspired by Go, or weiqi in Chinese,

originated in China more than 4,000 years ago.

Go is one of

earliest binary-based (基于二元的) games. The movements of the black and white pieces reflect the basic ideas of Eastern philosophy, according to Tu Ningning, who is in charge of the exhibition.

“The exhibition brings together Go culture, cutting-edge technology and contemporary art,” says Tu. “We hope

(present) the rather abstract Go game and AI in a visual context, and initiate dialogues with minimalist art, conceptual art and expressionism.”

“In a Go game, each move should serve a long-term goal. You try to lead the opponent into your trap and force them to follow your

(guide) till they lose,” explains Wang Wei, a Go player among the visitors to the exhibition.

“The players’ personalities
(reveal) during the game, and one’s weaknesses are exposed to the opponent,” she adds. “A decent winner always

no more than one or two points as a gesture (姿态) of respect for the other side.”

Tu says that the balance between the black and white pieces, the beauty in the
the energy flow following each move inspired artists to create oil paintings, sculptures,
(digital) generated pictures and silk-screen prints for the exhibition.

gaps.explanationZh: 非限制性定语从句修饰 Go，使用关系代词 which。
one of the + 形容词最高级/序数意义短语，使用定冠词 the。
hope 后接不定式作宾语，present 使用 to present。
your 后需要名词，guide 变为 guidance。
personalities 与 reveal 构成被动关系，且主语为复数，使用 are revealed。
主语 a decent winner 为第三人称单数，一般现在时使用 tries。
by no more than 表示不超过，使用介词 by。
placement 前需要形容词，strategy 变为 strategic。
the balance、the beauty 和 the energy flow 是并列成分，使用 and。
generated 前需要副词修饰，digital 变为 digitally。
